facts.text: Located on the Magnificent Mile within Water Tower Place
facts.excerpt: Located on the Magnificent Mile within the landmark Water Tower Place

facts.text: The Presidential Suite spans two floors and about 2,900 square feet, with views of Lake Michigan and the city skyline
facts.excerpt: Encompassing two floors, the Presidential Suite spans 2,900 square feet and offers a taste of luxury living. Upon entering the room, guests are greeted by unparalleled views of Lake Michigan and the city’s skyline.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a media room, a wet bar and a full-service kitchen
facts.excerpt: The full-service kitchen, island and spacious dining area are perfect for entertaining. Other highlights include a media room, a wet bar, two bathrooms and a guest powder room.

facts.text: Skyline Suites are on the 30th floor and have a galley kitchen and a dining table for eight
facts.excerpt: On the 30th floor, the 1,000 square foot Skyline Suites resides and offers apartment-style living with a galley kitchen and a dining table for eight.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers five food and beverage presentations each day
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not include complimentary Club access
facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: Torali Italian - Steak serves prime steak, handmade pastas and award-winning desserts
facts.excerpt: Highlights at this Italian restaurant in Chicago's Gold Coast include prime steak, handmade pastas, and award-winning desserts.

facts.text: Rooftop at Torali is a rooftop bar on the 12th floor with city and lake views
facts.excerpt: Enjoy city and lake views from the 12th floor at Rooftop at Torali.

facts.text: The Café is a greenhouse-inspired rooftop bar serving specialty coffees, pastries and desserts
facts.excerpt: This greenhouse-inspired rooftop bar in downtown Chicago is perfect for enjoying specialty coffees, fresh juices, sandwiches, pastries, and decadent desserts served daily.

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and views of Navy Pier and Lake Michigan
facts.excerpt: state-of-the-art fitness equipment, including Peloton® Exercise Bikes and Woodway Treadmills.

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week
facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

facts.text: The pool is a lap pool topped by a glass atrium
facts.excerpt: 52’ lap pool topped by a glass atrium, providing natural light throughout the year.

facts.text: Spa treatments include facials, massages and body treatments
facts.excerpt: It features an extensive offering of massage, facial, and body treatments.

facts.text: Children are greeted on arrival with a red wagon from which they can pick a toy to take home
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids are greeted by our Ladies and Gentlemen with the Red Wagon upon arrival and can pick their toy of choice to take home with them as a souvenir from their visit to Chicago.

facts.text: Children can order from Ritz Kids Healthy Menus in the hotel's restaurants
facts.excerpt: children can enjoy a Chicago themed coloring book and Ritz Kids Healthy Menus

facts.text: The Chef's Presidential Tasting Journey is a caviar and champagne tasting led by Executive Chef Damion Henry in the Presidential Suite
facts.excerpt: Indulge in an intimate caviar and champagne tasting led by Executive Chef Damion Henry in the refined elegance of The Ritz-Carlton, Chicago’s Presidential Suite.

facts.text: The Unexpected Vineyard experience flies guests by private helicopter to a Michigan vineyard for a tasting and lunch
facts.excerpt: Soar from Chicago by private helicopter to a curated Michigan vineyard for an exclusive tasting, lunch, and same-day return with an elegant dinner finale.

facts.text: The art collection celebrates Chicago's steel skyline and the waters of Lake Michigan
facts.excerpt: Chicago’s famed steel skyline and surrounding waters of Lake Michigan are celebrated throughout the spaces.

facts.text: Wi-Fi in the rooms is not complimentary unless you are a Marriott Bonvoy member
facts.excerpt: Good Wi-Fi, but it's not complimentary unless you are a Marriott Bonvoy member (it's also not included in the rate.)

facts.text: The lobby has a glass-roofed café area that serves as a coffee shop by day and a drinks spot by night
facts.excerpt: The lobby is energized by a glass-roofed café area that serves as a coffee shop by day, special drinks spot by night, with views of the city lights.

facts.text: Even the smallest rooms have a sofa and desk beside the picture windows
facts.excerpt: even the smallest ones have a sofa and desk beside the picture windows

facts.text: Rooms have Nespresso coffee machines
facts.excerpt: Covetable Nespresso coffee machines and generous supply of coffee capsules.

facts.text: A 20% service charge is added to spa services
facts.excerpt: a 20% automatic service charge will be added to all services

facts.text: Rooftop at Torali is open seasonally
facts.excerpt: Rooftop at Torali (open seasonally)
